capstones.name: Spire of the Warlord
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +20% to all stats, +15% damage, +15% mitigation. The warlord's spire.

capstones.name: Spire of Holiness
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +20% healing, +15% damage vs undead, group gains +10% mitigation.
capstones.description: Holiness radiates from the paladin's spire.

capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +25% fist damage, +20% dodge, +15% accuracy.

capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +30% backstab damage, +20% crit chance, +15% accuracy.

capstones.name: Spire of Savagery

capstones.name: Spire of the Predator
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +25% ranged damage, +20% crit chance, track range doubled.

capstones.name: Spire of Death
